_what: THE DECLARED JOIN from wave-3 substrate cards to L0 manifest part ids. W3-m-6.
_why_declared_and_not_derived: MEASURED, NOT ASSUMED: 9 of 13 wave-3 cards carry PROSE in artifact.location.home (whitespace-bearing), because SUBSTRATE_CARD.v2 types that field as a bare string with no joinability constraint -- unlike joinable_ref.id, which v2 REJECTS when it contains ' -- ' or ' ('. An EXACT-equality join on home therefore resolves only 2 of 13. A SUBSTRING join is what produced 1.0.0_SA_CTO~X's own 10/3 estimate, which they correctly flagged as INDICATIVE, and it is unsound here for a measured reason: the part id 'cse' substring-matches any prose containing the letters c-s-e, and a file-grain join maps derive_runner PATH A and PATH B onto the SAME parts, which would blend two write paths the wave split precisely to keep apart. So the join that cannot be derived is DECLARED here, one row per card, each carrying its own basis and evidence, in a file a validator can read.
_grain: ONE ROW PER CARD, at (file, write path) grain -- the cards' grain, not file grain.
_partition_sums: 13 = 9 enrich + 3 add + 1 unresolved. A partition whose parts do not sum is a residual bucket.

rows.evidence: EXACT equality: card artifact.location.home 'infra/aws/globgrph/kuzu_db' == part kuzu_db home. No prose, no substring. One of only 2 of 13 cards that join mechanically.
EXACT equality: card home 'infra/aws/globgrph/kuzu_stitch_db' == part kuzu_stitch_db home.

Card home states 'writes to globgrph.<args.table>, default globgrph.cse'. Part 'cse' IS globgrph.cse. NOTE CARRIED INTO THE PART: this writer is CLASS 3 / UNBOUNDED, so the part captures the DEFAULT target only and is NOT a complete statement of what this path can write.

Card home states 'acts on globgrph.<args.table>' -- same default target as PATH A, DESTRUCTIVE path. Enriches the same part; the two paths are kept distinguishable inside declared_opinions by source-prefixing rather than merged.
Card home states 'writes globgrph.<args.table>, default globgrph.resource_summaries'. Part 'resource_summaries' IS that table. CLASS 3 caveat as above.

⛔ DELIBERATELY NOT WRITTEN, and this is a verdict rather than an omission. The card's own home reads 'A LOCAL FILESYSTEM PATH, bound at runtime from --out (argparse :372) ... THE BOUND IS CLASS 3 -- ARBITRARY RUNTIME INPUT'. An artifact whose identity is an unconstrained CLI arg HAS NO STABLE PART ID, so registering one would mint a part that names a location the next run can change. The L0 part model requires a `home`; this write path cannot supply a durable one. Registering it under its DEFAULT basename would assert a stability the card explicitly measured as absent.

findings_surfaced_not_resolved: CONTRACT GAP -- SUBSTRATE_CARD.v2 `artifact.location.home` is a bare string with no joinability constraint, and 9 of 13 wave-3 cards populate it with prose. v2 already solved exactly this for `joinable_ref.id` by REJECTING ids containing ' -- ' or ' (' after measuring 51 raw entries collapsing to 43 subjects. The same fix was not applied to `home`, so the field that the L0 compile step must join on is the one field it cannot join on. THIS IS THE 'I COMPLY WHERE A VALIDATOR WATCHES' LAW ON A FRESH POPULATION: constrained field 13 of 13 clean, unconstrained neighbour 4 of 13 clean. NOT A LANE DEFECT -- no lane could have avoided it while following the schema, and for an Iceberg table on a Nessie branch there is no canonical short form to write. Owner: the SUBSTRATE_CARD.v2 schema owner.

CONTRACT GAP -- L0 `generation` is SINGULAR (one materializer, one materializer_standing, one cadence, one trigger) but wave 3 MEASURED graph_nodes as having THREE writers (derive_runner PATH A, comp_aws_cli, incremental_updater PATH A) and graph_edges TWO, and cse TWO write paths of one file that differ in authority. 1.0.0_SA_CTO~X ruled 30 minutes earlier that MATERIALIZER IS A RELATION, NOT A PROPERTY; this is that ruling meeting the contract that encodes it as a property. The existing 39 already route around it by writing multi-writer PROSE into generation.materializer. This compiler does NOT blend: on multi-writer parts it keeps the existing standing when contributing cards disagree and source-prefixes every declared_opinion. Owner: the L0 schema owner (1.0.0_SA_CTO~X).

STALE ATTRIBUTION IN THE EXISTING 39 -- part `fedobs_coevolution_snap` names generation.materializer = infra/aws/globgrph/cse_emit_frontend_coevolution.py, but wave 3 carded BOTH of that file's write paths and NEITHER writes that Iceberg table (PATH A = local JSONL, PATH B = an S3 watermark object). 2.0.0_SA_COO~X independently falsified the same claim in 74880 ('FALSIFIED, zero references'). Either a third write path exists uncarded, or the attribution is wrong. NOT RESOLVED HERE -- flagged on the part itself so the next reader inherits the doubt rather than the claim. Owner: 2.0.0_SA_COO~X / 0.8.0_AE_CloudComp~Y.

CONTRACT GAP -- L0 v1 gives each part ONE `basis` covering twelve fields (existence, home, vintage, lineage, generation, coverage...). SUBSTRATE_CARD.v2 solved exactly this class with `basis_by_field`, added after measuring 4 of 21 rows in ACCEPTED cards reading basis='measured' while carrying a HELD sub-claim. The same defect is unfixed one level up. MEASURED HERE, ON MYSELF: my first compiler took a floor across contributing cards' generation-row bases and drove graph_nodes from `measured` to `absent` -- because comp_aws_cli's cadence.basis is genuinely `absent` -- which would have published 'no basis exists yet' for a part whose existence, home and vintage were all measured. A single scalar over a mixed-provenance unit forces a choice between over-claiming and destroying a true claim. The compiler now keeps the part-level basis and records the generation-row floor in evidence, which is the F-2 shape (a claim living where a validator cannot branch on it) accepted knowingly because L0 v1 has nowhere else to put it. Owner: the L0 schema owner (1.0.0_SA_CTO~X).

CLAIM-PRESERVATION -- a card's `actual_trigger: null` with cadence.basis=measured means MEASURED NONE-FOUND; L0's `trigger: null` means NOT KNOWN. Passing the null straight through silently converts a hard measured negative into an absence of information, and the DTX3 cards' none-found verdict was the most expensive measurement in that delivery. The compiler now writes 'NONE-FOUND (measured)' / 'NONE DECLARED (measured)' so the claim survives the fold. Caught by spot-reading the compiler's own output rather than by any gate.
